newsitem.title: RUSSIA: Yeltsin feels "absolutely normal", doctor says.
newsitem.headline: Yeltsin feels "absolutely normal", doctor says.

text.p: Russian President Boris Yeltsin feels "absolutely normal" after heart surgery, Itar-Tass news agency quoted chief Kremlin doctor Sergei Mironov as saying on Friday.
Mironov said Yeltsin, who had a multiple bypass operation on November 5, was taking two or three walks a day and gradually building up his exercise load.

He confirmed that the 65-year-old president would be able to start visiting the Kremlin from December 5, one month after the operation, and would be able to have a "fuller" work schedule from December 20. He gave no other details.
Yeltsin is recovering in the Barvikha sanatorium outside Moscow. He fell ill just before he was re-elected on July 3 and has spent little time in the Kremlin since then.
